spans.s:
अङ्क् अङ्क्, cl. 1. A. अङ्कते, आनङ्के,
अङ्किष्यते, अङ्कितुम्, to move in a
curve; to mark; cl. 10. P. अङ्कयति, -यितुम्, to
move in a curve; to mark, stamp, brand; (this rt.
is related to अञ्च्.)

अङ्क अङ्क, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अञ्च्, but connected
with preceding rt. अङ्क्), a hook; a curve or bend; the
curve in the human, especially the female, figure above
the hip, where infants (sitting astride) are carried by
Hindū mothers or nurses (hence often equivalent to
the English breast or lap); the side or flank; the
body; proximity, place; the bend in the arm; any
hook or crooked instrument; a curved line; a nu-
[]
merical figure, cipher; a figure or mark branded on
an animal, &c.; any mark, line, stroke, ornament,
stigma; a number; the number nine; a coefficient;
an act of a drama; a drama; a military show or
sham-fight; a misdeed, a sin; moving in a curve [cf.
Gr. ὄγκος and Lat. uncus].
—अङ्क-करण, अम्,
n. the act of marking or stamping.
—अङ्क-तन्त्र,
अम्, n. title of a book treating of magical marks or
figures.
—अङ्क-धारणा, f. manner of holding the
body, figure.
—अङ्क-परिवर्तन, अम्, n. turning
the body, turning on the other side.
—अङ्क-पाद-
व्रत, अम्, n. title of a chapter in the Bhaviṣyot-
tara Purāṇa.
—अङ्क-पालि, इस्, f. or आङ्क-पालिका,
f. embracing, an embrace.
—अङ्क-पाली, f. an em-
brace; a nurse; a plant, Piring or Medicago Escu-
lenta.
—अङ्क-पाश, अस्, m. a peculiar concatenation
of numerals or numbers.
—अङ्कपाश-व्यवहार,
अस्, m. the use of that concatenation.
—अङ्कपाशा-
ध्याय (˚श-अध्˚), अस्, m. the study or use of that
concatenation.
—अङ्क-बन्ध, अस्, m. branding with
a mark that resembles a headless body.
—अङ्क-भाज्,
क्, क्, क्, an infant carried on the hip; forced fruit,
nearly ripe, early ripe.
—अङ्क-मुख, अम्, n.
the act of a drama which gives a clue to the whole
plot.
—अङ्क-लोड्य, अस्, m., N. of a plant or its
root, ginger, Ciñcoḍa or Ciñcoṭaka.
—अङ्क-
विद्या, f. arithmetic.
—अङ्काङ्क (˚क-अङ्˚), अम्, n.,
Ved. water.
—अङ्कावतार (˚क-अव्˚), अस्, m. the
closing part of a dramatic scene.

अङ्कति, इस्, m. wind; fire; Brahmā; a Brāhman
who maintains the sacred fire.

अङ्कन, अम्, n. the act of marking, stamping,
branding, ciphering, writing; (अस्, आ, अम्), marking.
अङ्कस्, अस्, n. tortuous motion, a mark; the body.

अङ्कस, अम्, n. the flanks (?) or the trappings of
a horse.

अङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked, branded; numbered,
counted, calculated.

अङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, having an अङ्क, q. v.; (ई), m. a
small drum; (इनी), f. a number of marks, &c.
अङ्की, f. a small drum.
अङ्कुट, अस्, m. a key.
अङ्कुप, अम्, n., Ved. water.

अङ्कुर or अङ्कूर, अस्, m. a sprout, shoot, blade;
a hair; blood; water; a swelling, a tumour.
अङ्कूर, अस्, m. a sprout. See अङ्कुर.
अङ्कुरक, अस्, m. a nest.
अङ्कुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, sprouted.

अङ्कुश, अस्, अम्, m. n. a hook, especially an
elephant-driver's hook; (आ) or (ई), f. one of the
twenty-four Jaina goddesses [cf. Gr. ἄγκσιτρον Germ.
Angel].
—अङ्कुश-ग्रह, अस्, m. an elephant-driver.
—अङ्कुश-दुर्धर, अस्, m. a restive elephant.
अङ्कुशित, अस्, आ, अम्, urged on by the hook.
अङ्कूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. a hook; an ichneumon.

अङ्कुशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a hook, laying hold of
with a hook.

अङ्कूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. (fr. a nom. अङ्कूय,
related to अङ्क), moving tortuously (to escape).

अङ्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit or proper to be marked
or counted; (अस्), m. a small drum [cf. अङ्की].
अङ्कार अङ्कार, अस्, m. diminution in music.

अङ्कोट अङ्कोट or अङ्कोठ or अङ्कोल or
अङ्कोलक, अस्, m. a plant, Alangium Hexapetalum.
—अङ्कोल्ल-सार, अस्, m. a poison, probably prepared
from the plant called Aṅkola, &c.

अङ्कोलिका अङ्कोलिका, f. (a corruption of
अङ्क-पालिका, q. v.), an embrace.

अङ्क्त्वा अङ्क्त्वा, ind. (part. fr. rt. अञ्ज्),
having besmeared.

आङ्कुशायन आङ्कुशायन, adj. formed fr.
अङ्कुश. See Gaṇa to Pāṇini
आङ्कृति आङ्कृति, इस्, m., N. of a prince.

आङ्क्षी आङ्क्षी, f. a musical instrument, a
tabor.

अङ्क-भाज्; add — close to one's side; in one's
possession, anything which is close or easy of attain-
ment, close at hand.
